detail.longDescription: Plenty of apps will run a Pomodoro timer. Not many will shut down the things that break the session for you. Session sets an intention, runs the timer, blocks the websites and apps you named, prompts the break, then reports on where the time actually went. Shortcuts and URL schemes can start a configured session from a link. From the ScreenCastsONLINE library: https://www. screencastsonline.com/tutorial s/show/session # Productivity # Mac # Focus
